title: Privilege escalation in the DevTools component
description: A privilege escalation vulnerability has been identified in the DevTools component of Microsoft software version 4.0. The vulnerability is cataloged as CVE-2026-92055 and relates to improper authorization (CWE-269). No CVSS score or detailed technical impact information is provided. There is no indication of active exploitation in the wild, and no patch or remediation information is currently available.
